Sector modules

What each industry module includes.

15 items

  • 01Forwarders, transporters, 3PLs

    Logistics & Freight

    • Rates, quotations and shipments — FCL/LCL, air and road
    • Containers, customs workflow, transport and drivers
    • Warehouse, POD, job costing and customer portal

    Why it's different · Profitability per job, not per month.

  • 02Agencies and DMCs

    Travel & Tourism

    • Travel CRM, quotations and bookings
    • Flights, hotels, transfers, attractions and visas
    • Suppliers, refunds and booking profitability

    Trading & Distribution

    • Price lists, customer pricing and quotations
    • Orders, stock, delivery and returns
    • Receivables, supplier bills and margin analysis
  • 04Brokerages and property managers

    Real Estate

    • Listings, units, owners, tenants and agents
    • Leads, viewings, sales and leases
    • Rent, commissions, maintenance and portals

    • Subcontractors, labour, site, equipment, quality and safety
    • Variations, progress billing and costing

    • Contracts, sites and assets
    • Preventive maintenance, work orders and SLA
    • Technicians, parts, field app and billing

    Professional Services

    • Contracts, billing and documents
    • Client portal
  • 08Agencies and in-house teams

    Recruitment

    • ATS, interviews and placements
    • Documents and billing
  • 09Stores and chains

    Retail

    • POS, inventory and purchasing
    • Pricing, promotions and loyalty
    • E-commerce and delivery

    Automotive

    • Vehicles and customers

    • Sales and rentals
  • 11Hotels and restaurants

    Hospitality
